EN: Ha ha yes, you have gotten us. You are funny and as humans we like to laugh.
ZH: 哈哈，是的，你抓住我们了。你很有趣，作为人类我们喜欢笑。

EN: All lights in the sky are normal. You were confused by the planet Venus ha ha.
ZH: 天空中所有的光都是正常的。你被金星搞糊涂了哈哈。

EN: Ha ha, just kidding. Humor is a distinctive human trait, wink wink.
ZH: 哈哈，开玩笑的。幽默是人类特有的特征，眨眼。

EN: Greetings, fellow human beings, and welcome to our Vault.
ZH: 人类同胞们，你们好，欢迎来到我们的避难所。

EN: It is good to encounter you, because we are a social, gregarious species.
ZH: 很高兴遇见你们，因为我们是个爱好社交、群居的物种。

EN: Please feel free to walk among us, all beings hatched and grown on this planet.
ZH: 请随便在这儿走走，这个星球上所有生命都是孵化长大的。

EN: Would you like beverages, foodstuff, or a complimentary exam?
ZH: 您要饮料、食物，还是来一次免费的体检？

EN: This isn't really a Vault, it's an abandoned mine.
ZH: 这不是一个真正的避难所，这是一个废弃的矿井。

EN: Have you guys seen strange lights in the sky?
ZH: 你们看到天空中奇怪的光了吗？

EN: Sorry, complimentary what?
ZH: 对不起，赠送什么？

EN: Everything here is normal human stuff, no space aliens on a mission or anything.
ZH: 这里的一切都是正常人类的东西，没有外星人在执行任务。

EN: Ha ha “take us to your leader” - I got that humorous cultural reference.
ZH: 哈哈，“带我们去见你们的领导”——这个幽默的文化梗我可听懂了。

EN: [High-pitched guttural shriek]
ZH: [高音喉咙尖叫]

EN: Oh, sorry, I thought you were someone else ha ha.
ZH: 哦，对不起，我以为你是别人呢哈哈。

EN: It is good to talk to other humans using human-made sounds.
ZH: 用人类制造的声音与他人交谈是件好事。

EN: Please ask me a question so we may engage in a conversation.
ZH: 请向我提个问题吧，这样我们就能交谈了。

EN: Seen anything strange lately?
ZH: 最近有什么奇怪的事吗？

EN: Can we see your Overseer?
ZH: 我们可以见见你们的监督者吗？

EN: There is no need, you should go back home to enjoy a nice beverage and foodstuff.
ZH: 没必要调查，你们应该回家享用上好的饮料和食品。

EN: Ha ha well we were hatched in the same pod, so to speak ha ha.
ZH: 哈哈，可以这么说吧，我们是在同一个孵化舱里孵出来的，哈哈。

EN: Good catch ha ha but seriously we do need females if you can spare some that'd be great.
ZH: 说的好，哈哈，不过说真的，如果你能留一些的话，我们确实需要雌性的。

EN: Look, John Smith, other fellow human beings like us ha ha.
ZH: 看，约翰·史密斯，是其他和我们一样的人类同胞，哈哈。

EN: Hello there, I am the human called John Smith, which is a human name.
ZH: 你好，我是叫约翰·史密斯的人类，这是一个人类的名字。

EN: My friend here is also called John Smith, so you can tell he is also human.
ZH: 我的朋友也叫约翰·史密斯，你可以看出他也是人类。

EN: Neither of us is hiding his true form with optical camouflage, that would be absurd ha ha.
ZH: 我们俩都没有用光学伪装来掩盖真实面目，那太可笑了哈哈。

EN: We're investigating strange lights in this area.
ZH: 我们正在调查这个地区的奇怪灯光。

EN: Nice to meet you both. Are you related?
ZH: 很高兴见到你们俩。你俩是亲戚吗？

EN: I don't see many women here... Are you guys all male?
ZH: 我在这里没看到多少女人……你们都是男的吗？

EN: Ha ha you say Zeta Reticuli a, I say Zeta Reticuli b...
ZH: 哈哈，你说是网罟座泽塔星a，我说是网罟座泽塔星b……

EN: It is through collaboration that our primitive species evolves!
ZH: 正是通过合作，我们的原始物种才得以进化！

EN: I would very much like to telephone home.
ZH: 我很想打电话回家。

EN: Ha ha just kidding, this Vault is our home now.
ZH: 哈哈，开玩笑的，这个避难所现在是我们的家了。

EN: We just need to make the large, stinging invertebrates leave.
ZH: 我们只需要让那些大型的，带刺的无脊椎动物离开。

EN: They like killing us, for some reason ha ha.
ZH: 他们喜欢杀我们，出于某种原因，哈哈。

EN: This isn't a Vault, it's a cave.
ZH: 这不是一个避难所，这是一个洞穴。

EN: You mean Radscorpions? We'll take care of those.
ZH: 你是说辐射蝎？我们会处理的。

EN: Super, now go tell others never to come here because everything is normal ha ha.
ZH: 太棒了，现在去告诉别人永远不要来这里，因为一切都是正常的哈哈。

EN: Ha ha no problem just look inside the opening of this pistol-like artefact.
ZH: 哈哈，没问题，请往这个手枪状器物的开口里面看就行。

EN: ALERT! ALERT! ENGAGE EXTERMINATION PROTOCOL!
ZH: 警报！警报！进行灭绝协议！

EN: Ah, the other humans of which we have heard. I am the one called Overseer.
ZH: 啊，就是我们听说过的其他人类。我就是那个被称为“监督者”的。

EN: I hope you find everything here normal and not at all disquieting ha ha.
ZH: 我希望你在这里一切正常，一点也不觉得不安呵呵。

EN: It is important that you do not feel like you are examined by superior beings.
ZH: 重要的是，你不要觉得自己是在接受上级的检查。

EN: Please confirm that you do not feel like you are examined by superior beings.
ZH: 请确认你不觉得自己正被高等存在审视。

EN: You guys seem like pretty regular folks.
ZH: 你们看起来很普通。

EN: About those strange lights...
ZH: 关于那些奇怪的光……

EN: Well, you guys are a *little* bit weird.
ZH: 好吧，你们真是有点奇怪。

EN: There have been several reports of strange lights hovering over the Wasteland not far from here. The lights were congregating over an old abandoned mine. We need to investigate this before rumors of alien visitors start spreading!
ZH: 有好几份报告说，在离这里不远的废土上有奇怪的光在盘旋。灯光聚集在一个废弃的旧矿井上。我们需要在外星人入侵的谣言开始传播之前进行调查！

EN: Humans Like Us
ZH: 和我们一样的人类

EN: Talk to the mysterious Overseer.
ZH: 和神秘的监督者交谈。

EN: Talk to the mysterious Dwellers.
ZH: 与神秘的居民交谈。

EN: Investigate strange aerial lights.
ZH: 调查空中的奇怪光芒。

EN: No Jersey. But what's this...
ZH: 没有棒球衫。但这是什么……

EN: A Rackie Jobinson baseball card!
ZH: 一张罗基·杰宾森的棒球卡！

EN: There's something written on the back...
ZH: 背后好像写了什么……

EN: “This is as close as you're going to get! - Coach”
ZH: “你们最多也就只能得到这个了！- 教练”

EN: If Coach has the Jersey, maybe he needs to keep it clean. We're off to search the BubblySuds Laundromat!
ZH: 如果教练手里有棒球衫的话，也许他需要保持干净。我们去泡泡多自助洗衣店看看吧！

EN: I Don't Know's on Third!
ZH: “不知道”在三垒！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Wow, there's a lot of Ghouls here!
ZH: 哇，这里尸鬼真多！

EN: That's gotta be the boss. Keep your RadAway ready!
ZH: 那肯定是个首领。准备好你的消辐宁！

EN: We've received a distress call from some Minutemen. Apparently some Ghouls have attacked one of their outposts. Help them out, and maybe they'll join our fight against the Institute!
ZH: 我们收到一些义勇军的求救信号。显然有一群尸鬼袭击了他们的一个前哨站。帮他们一把，说不定他们会加入我们对抗学院！

EN: Hold on a Minuteman
ZH: 坚持住，义勇军！

EN: Rescue citizens
ZH: 拯救平民

EN: Rescue the Minutemen Commander
ZH: 拯救义勇军指挥官

EN: Defeat the Glowing One
ZH: 击败发光种

EN: Rescue the Minutemen and defeat the feral Ghouls attacking their outpost.
ZH: 拯救义勇军并击败袭击他们前哨站的狂尸鬼。

EN: Boy, am I glad to see you. I was about to panic. I'm a new recruit!
ZH: 天哪，见到你太高兴了。我差点就要惊慌失措了。我是新兵！

EN: God bless you. Oh! Take this. Save some for the Commander, will you?
ZH: 上帝保佑你。哦！拿着这个。给指挥官留点，好吗？

EN: Wow, you're scary! Here, take this. Save some for the Commander, will you?
ZH: 哇，你可真吓人！来，拿着。给指挥官留点，好吗？

EN: Don't worry, Private. We'll get them out.
ZH: 别担心，二等兵。我们会把他们救出来的。

EN: You know what Feral Ghouls have nightmares about? Me.
ZH: 你知道狂尸鬼的噩梦是什么吗？是我。

EN: There's enough Feral Ghouls in there to give me nightmares my whole life.
ZH: 里面的狂尸鬼多到足够让我做一辈子的噩梦了。

EN: I'm about as much help as a paper umbrella in a hurricane.
ZH: 我这点作用，就像飓风里的纸伞一样靠不住。

EN: I know the Commander wanted to strike a deal with you about the Institute…
ZH: 我知道指挥官想跟你谈笔关于学院的交易……

EN: But he's still inside! And there are civilians! Please save them!
ZH: 但他还在里面！还有平民！请救救他们！

EN: Oh, heaven have mercy! We're saved, boys!
ZH: 哦，老天开恩！我们有救了，兄弟们！

EN: Such bravery! Please take this… to remember us by.
ZH: 多么勇敢！请收下这个……留作纪念。

EN: Right you are. But first, please, take this. No, I insist!
ZH: 你说得对。但先请收下这个。不，别推辞！

EN: You can have everything! It's all we've got, except our lives.
ZH: 你可以全都拿走！除了性命，这就是我们的全部家当了。

EN: All in a day's work, ma'am.
ZH: 家常便饭而已，女士。

EN: Save your breath for running.
ZH: 省点力气用来逃命吧。

EN: We're no saviors. We expect something in return.
ZH: 我们可不是救世主。我们是要回报的。

EN: We are saved, right? I heard a lot of noises that sounded like dying Ghouls.
ZH: 我们有救了，对吧？我听到好多像是尸鬼濒死的声音。

EN: Hey! It's you! And I already told my Mama I was gonna see her soon.
ZH: 嘿！是你们！我已经跟我妈说很快就能见到她了。

EN: Guess she'll have to wait a while longer.
ZH: 看来她得多等一阵子了。

EN: Love to stay and chat, but I gotta go see to my ensign.
ZH: 真想留下来聊聊天，但我得去照看我的少尉。

EN: I heard you had problems with the Institute. We do, too. Big problems.
ZH: 我听说你们跟学院有梁子。我们也有。大麻烦。

EN: I'll be in touch about coordinating our efforts. See you.
ZH: 我会联系你们协调作战。再见。

EN: I assume you're here to collect me. I don't want your help.
ZH: 我猜你们是来接我的。我不需要你们帮忙。

EN: Isn't it obvious? Maybe you're a Synth, too, and you're here to take me away and silence me. Please go.
ZH: 这还不明显吗？也许你也是个合成人，你是来抓我、让我闭嘴的。请走吧。

EN: My trust? You just want to feel superior. Just like the Synths… Just like everyone. Go away.
ZH: 信任你？你只是想显得自己高人一等。就像那些合成人……就像所有人。走开。

EN: What are you so afraid of?
ZH: 你到底在怕什么？

EN: How can I earn your trust?
ZH: 我怎样才能赢得你的信任？

EN: Feral Ghouls are the only trustworthy people left in the Commonwealth.
ZH: 狂尸鬼是联邦仅存的值得信赖的人了。

EN: They're not great company, but at least they'll look me in the eye when they kill me.
ZH: 它们算不上好同伴，但至少杀我的时候，会看着我的眼睛。

EN: I ran away from the Covenant. So I know all about this stuff.
ZH: 我是从圣约村逃出来的。所以这一套我懂得很。

EN: Attempt to blend in has failed. Activating combat routine.
ZH: 伪装失败。启动战斗程序。

EN: The Covenant could be a helpful ally against the Institute. Use your natural charisma to get as many of them on board as you can.
ZH: 圣约村可以成为对抗学院的有力盟友。用你天生的魅力，尽可能多地说服他们加入。

EN: Convenient Covenant
ZH: 顺手的圣约村

EN: Talk the Covenant into joining our cause.
ZH: 说服圣约村加入我们的事业。

EN: Persuade the Covenant to help against the Institute.
ZH: 说服圣约村协助对抗学院。

EN: Hold on. First, we gotta do a test.
ZH: 且慢。首先，我们得做个测试。

EN: … Are you joking? You're not. Well, at least you didn't say “catcher”. Go on in.
ZH: ……你在开玩笑吗？你是认真的。好吧，至少你没说“捕手”。进去吧。

EN: How suspicious. Why'd you specify “human”? I'll have to report this… in the mean time, go on in.
ZH: 真可疑。你为什么要特别说“人类”？我得把这事报告上去……先这样吧，进去吧。

EN: I don't really know, either. Well, you didn't say “catcher”, so you can go on in.
ZH: 我自己也不大清楚。嗯，你没说“捕手”，所以可以进去了。

EN: The ball.
ZH: 球。

EN: The bat.
ZH: 球棒。

EN: A human player.
ZH: 人类球员。

EN: What's baseball?
ZH: 棒球是什么？

EN: So, let's say you're on a baseball team.
ZH: 那好，假设你在一支棒球队里。

EN: What position would you be best suited for?
ZH: 你最擅长哪个位置？

EN: Hi there, sorry about the test. She's in training.
ZH: 你好，刚才的测试，抱歉啊——她还在受训。

EN: I'm glad you think so. I've got to take care of something, but I'll meet you downstairs.
ZH: 我很高兴你这么想。我有点事要处理，一会儿楼下见。

EN: Good luck. I've got to take care of something, but I'll meet you downstairs.
ZH: 祝你好运。我有点事要处理，一会儿楼下见。

EN: Hm. We can be pretty stubborn. Well, anyway, I've got to take care of something, so I'll meet you downstairs.
ZH: 嗯。我们可是出了名的固执。好吧，总之我有点事要处理，楼下见。

EN: Sounds reasonable. See you later.
ZH: 听起来合理。回头见。

EN: Let's see what we can do!
ZH: 看看我们能做点什么！

EN: Psh, that'll be easy. It's as good as sealed.
ZH: 切，那还不容易。这事板上钉钉了。

EN: So, you want to join forces with the Covenant? To fight the Institute?
ZH: 所以，你们想和圣约村联手？一起对抗学院？

EN: We're not much for fighting, but we do hate the Institute.
ZH: 我们不太擅长打仗，但我们确实恨学院。

EN: Tell you what. If you can persuade the rest of my folks to join, we're in.
ZH: 这样吧。只要你能说服我其他乡亲们加入，我们就入伙。

EN: You want us to fight the institute?
ZH: 你想让我们去对抗学院？

EN: You're right! They do! Now I'm mad. I'm on board. Here, take this for the cause.
ZH: 你说得对！他们确实！现在我火大了。我入伙。来，为了这项事业，收下这个。

EN: Ooh, wow. That would be way more meaningful. Okay, you've convinced me. Take this, it'll help.
ZH: 哦，哇。那可有意义多了。好吧，你说服我了。拿着这个，会有用的。

EN: No way. Not interested in that kind of science. I'm out.
ZH: 没门。我对那种科学没兴趣。我不干了。

EN: The Institute's espionage sullies the very name of research.
ZH: 学院的间谍行径，玷污了研究的名声。

EN: If we beat them, you could go back to studying actual humans.
ZH: 如果我们打败他们，你就能回去研究真正的人类了。

EN: You could help us make weapons!
ZH: 你可以帮我们造武器！

EN: I'm not a fighter, I'm a researcher. Why should we help you?
ZH: 我不是战士，我是研究员。我们为什么要帮你？

EN: I know why you're here. Look, I'm a soldier.
ZH: 我知道你为什么来。听着，我是军人。

EN: That's horrible! Picking on peaceful Vault dwellers?! I'll help. Starting with this.
ZH: 太恶劣了！欺负和平的避难所居民？！我加入。先收下这个。

EN: Agreed. Let's put an end to their production once and for all! Oh, take this with you.
ZH: 同意。让我们一劳永逸地终结他们的生产！哦，把这个带在身上。

EN: Everyone does. That's not a good enough reason to go killing people. Sorry.
ZH: 谁都会这么说。那不是去杀人的充分理由。抱歉。

EN: They're attacking our Vault and killing our Dwellers!
ZH: 他们袭击我们的避难所，杀害我们的居民！

EN: Synths are a threat we need to stop.
ZH: 合成人是我们必须阻止的威胁。

EN: The Institute treats everyone in the Wasteland like trash.
ZH: 学院把废土上的所有人都当成垃圾。

EN: I don't want to have to fight. But I will if there's a good reason.
ZH: 我不想去打仗。但只要有正当理由，我会的。

EN: What's your reason?
ZH: 你的理由是什么？

EN: Hey there. Did you like that test you got at the start?
ZH: 嘿。你喜欢一开始给你做的那个测试吗？

EN: Nope, I like my job. I won't help you.
ZH: 不喜欢，我喜欢我的工作。我不会帮你的。

EN: Hm. I hadn't considered that. I'll help. Take this, in case I don't see you again.
ZH: 嗯。我没考虑过这个。我加入。拿着这个，以防我们再也见不到了。

EN: No, but they're the best ones. Sorry, I want to keep the status quo. I like my job.
ZH: 不，但他们可是最厉害的。抱歉，我想维持现状。我喜欢我的工作。

EN: Wouldn't you prefer to do something else?
ZH: 难道你不想做点别的事吗？

EN: Think of the “interrogation” you could do with Institute leaders.
ZH: 想想你能对学院领导们做的“审问”。

EN: You think Synths are the only spies?
ZH: 你以为合成人是唯一的间谍？

EN: I helped design it. I'm an interrogator. I have caught a lot of Synths.
ZH: 我参与设计了它。我是审讯官。我抓到过很多合成人。

EN: The test is just a part. We have a lot of creative methods.
ZH: 测试只是一部分。我们有很多富有创意的方法。

EN: If we get rid of the Institute, I'm out of a job. Why should I help you?
ZH: 要是我们把学院铲除了，我就失业了。我凭什么帮你？

EN: Well, how did it go? Did everyone agree to help?
ZH: 怎么样了？大家都答应帮忙了吗？

EN: Great. I was secretly hoping they would. I would love to end that organization. See you out there.
ZH: 太好了。我私下里一直希望他们答应。我真想终结那个组织。战场上见。

EN: That's good enough. I really do hate the Institute. We'll support your assault.
ZH: 这就够了。我确实恨学院。我们会支持你的进攻。

EN: Hmm… I really do hate the Institute. I'll find you some volunteers, but not a full-scale commitment.
ZH: 嗯……我确实恨学院。我会帮你找些志愿者，但不会全力投入。

EN: Yes, all of them did.
ZH: 是的，他们都答应了。

EN: Some of them, not everyone.
ZH: 一些人答应了，不是全部。

EN: Nope, not one. Total waste of time.
ZH: 没，一个都没有。纯属浪费时间。

EN: Use of weapons by non-Robco personnel is strictly forbidden!
ZH: 非罗伯科人员严禁使用武器！

EN: Intruder alert! Intruder alert!
ZH: 入侵警报！入侵警报！

EN: Submit or be destroyed!
ZH: 投降，否则被摧毁！

EN: The Brotherhood needs us to retrieve some “secret blueprints” for them, from a RobCo research facility. If we do, they'll join our efforts, starting by give us some Fusion Cores!
ZH: 兄弟会需要我们替他们从一座罗伯科研究设施取回一些“机密蓝图”。只要办成，他们就会加入我们的行动，先给我们一些聚变核心作为回报！

EN: Core of Power
ZH: 力量核心

EN: Obtain the secret blueprints
ZH: 获取机密蓝图

EN: Get some blueprints for the Brotherhood in exchange for Fusion Cores.
ZH: 为兄弟会获取一些蓝图，换取聚变核心。

EN: Greetings, Vault folk. I'm here to supervise your mission.
ZH: 你们好，避难所的朋友。我是来监督你们任务的。

EN: At ease. Go forth and smash some metal.
ZH: 稍息。去把那堆金属砸烂吧。

EN: Good for you.
ZH: 不错。

EN: Help will come after the mission is completed, Vaultie.
ZH: 任务完成后自会有援助，避难所的朋友。

EN: Roger that, Sir.
ZH: 收到，长官。

EN: Yeah, I knew that.
ZH: 嗯，我早知道了。

EN: Got anything to help?
ZH: 有什么能帮上忙的吗？

EN: Remember, you must retrieve the blueprints from the RobCo computer.
ZH: 记住，你们必须从罗伯科的电脑里取回蓝图。

EN: If you can do that, you will prove yourself worthy allies, and we'll help you combat the Institute.
ZH: 你们若能办到，就能证明你们是合格的盟友，我们就会帮你们对抗学院。

EN: Beware the many security robots in this building.
ZH: 小心这栋楼里的众多安保机器人。

EN: Greetings! Welcome to RobCo Industries. What can we do for you?
ZH: 欢迎！欢迎来到罗伯科工业。请问有什么需要帮忙的？

EN: Why, certainly! Note that use of weapons will be met with deadly force. Enjoy!
ZH: 哎呀，当然！注意，使用武器将招来致命还击。玩得开心！

EN: Oh, I'm afraid we can't allow that. Please lower your weapons so we can kill you without conflict.
ZH: 哦，恐怕我们不能允许那样。请放下武器，好让我们毫无障碍地杀掉你们。

EN: The main computer is for employees only. No ID card? Then we'll just have to kill you!
ZH: 主机只供员工使用。没有员工证？那我们只能杀了你们！

EN: Uh, we'd like a tour.
ZH: 呃，我们想参观一下。

EN: We're looking for some secret blueprints?
ZH: 我们在找一些机密蓝图？

EN: Which way to the main computer?
ZH: 去主机怎么走？
